resolved.title: 什么是Javascript
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Welcome to JavaScript! [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Have you ever visited a website that made you think…"Wow, this website is really cool and interactive"? Well, JavaScript was probably making it happen. [img id="4864" width="100%"]
In this course, you'll learn to code with JavaScript - one of the most popular programming languages that makes websites dynamic and interactive. [note]You can also use JavaScript to create mobile apps and games, process data, and much more! [/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Welcome to JavaScript! [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Have you ever visited a website that made you think…"Wow, this website is really cool and interactive"? Well, JavaScript was probably making it happen. [img id="4864" width="100%"]
In this course, you'll learn to code with JavaScript - one of the most popular programming languages that makes websites dynamic and interactive. [note]You can also use JavaScript to create mobile apps and games, process data, and much more! [/note]

content.text:
相信大家在平时访问到了很多优秀的网站，不管是网站的视觉，还是交互，都让人觉得......“哇，这个网站真的很酷，很有互动性”。

这些功能或效果都是怎么实现的呢？这其中一定少不了Javascript!
content.text_html:
Have you ever visited a website that made you think…"Wow, this website is really cool and interactive"? Well, JavaScript was probably making it happen.

你是否曾经访问过一个网站，让你觉得...... "哇，这个网站真的很酷，很有互动性"？那么，可能是JavaScript让它发生的。

content.text:
JavaScript是一种**高级的**、**解释型的**编程语言，常用于Web应用程序的开发。它被广泛应用于动态交互式的Web页面开发。它可以与HTML和CSS结合使用，实现动态的页面效果和用户交互，可以通过浏览器内置的JavaScript解释器直接在浏览器中执行。

它具有简单易学、语法灵活、功能强大等特点，广受开发者喜爱。

你还可以用Javascript构建服务器端应用程序、移动应用程序和桌面应用程序等。

比如：
- 基于Node.js构建服务器端应用程序；
- 基于React Native构建移动端应用程序；
- 基于Electron构建桌面端应用程序。
content.text_html:
In this course, you'll learn to code with JavaScript - one of the most popular programming languages that makes websites dynamic and interactive.

在本课程中，你将学会用JavaScript编码--这是最流行的编程语言之一，能使网站变得动态和互动。

question_options.text: 一个非常流行的编程语言

resolved.title: 使用控制台-Console
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The Console[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

JavaScript is a programming language that runs in web browsers. Most websites use JavaScript and when things go wrong, web developers use the [b]console[/b] to investigate errors.

In this lesson you'll learn about the web developer’s main weapon: the developer’s [b]console[/b].
[note][b][/b]Coding errors are not visible in the browser. Web developers use the [b]console[/b] to test code and fix bugs. [/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The Console[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

JavaScript is a programming language that runs in web browsers. Most websites use JavaScript and when things go wrong, web developers use the [b]console[/b] to investigate errors.

In this lesson you'll learn about the web developer’s main weapon: the developer’s [b]console[/b].
[note][b][/b]Coding errors are not visible in the browser. Web developers use the [b]console[/b] to test code and fix bugs. [/note]

content.text:
Javascript是一种运行在浏览器环境的编程语言。基本上所有的在浏览器展示给用户的网站都是基于Javascript编写。所有运行在浏览器的网站都不一定100%稳定或完美，网站在运行的过程中或多或少会出现一些问题，那么开发人员如何处理或者定位这些问题呢？

在本课中，你将了解前端研发工程师的重要武器：浏览器的**控制台**
content.text_html:
JavaScript is a programming language that runs in web browsers. Most websites use JavaScript and when things go wrong, web developers use the console to investigate errors.

In this lesson you'll learn about the web developer’s main weapon: the developer’s console.

JavaScript是一种在网络浏览器中运行的编程语言。大多数网站都使用JavaScript，当出现问题时，网络开发人员会使用控制台来调查错误。

在本课中，你将了解网络开发者的主要武器：开发者的控制台。

content.text:
浏览器控制台(Console)是浏览器提供的一个命令行界面，它允许开发者在浏览器中执行 JavaScript 代码，并查看运行结果和错误信息。

控制台可以通过按下键盘上的F12或者右键点击页面中的任何元素并选择“检查元素”来打开。一旦打开控制台，您就可以输入 JavaScript 代码并按下回车键来执行它。控制台还可以用来查看网页中的错误和警告，例如 JavaScript 错误和未加载的资源。
content.text_html:
Coding errors are not visible in the browser. Web developers use the console to test code and fix bugs.

编码错误在浏览器中是不可见的。网络开发人员使用控制台来测试代码和修复错误。

resolved.question_text: 开发人员可以使用浏览器的控制台测试代码和修复BUGs
resolved.question_text_html: True or false? You can use the console to test code and fix bugs.

resolved.title: 打印日志
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logging Messages[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The console is part of the web browser. [b]Logging[/b] (writing) messages to the console is a good way to diagnose and troubleshoot minor issues in your code. 

You can use [b]console.log() [/b]to write or [b]log[/b] messages. In the example code below, the message 'All good, no errors' is sent to the console. [code format="js" codeId="5606"]console.log('All good, no errors') [/code]
[note]You can [b]log[/b] messages to inform what the code is doing or alert that there’s an issue.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logging Messages[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The console is part of the web browser. [b]Logging[/b] (writing) messages to the console is a good way to diagnose and troubleshoot minor issues in your code. 

You can use [b]console.log() [/b]to write or [b]log[/b] messages. In the example code below, the message 'All good, no errors' is sent to the console. [code format="js" codeId="5606"]console.log('All good, no errors') [/code]
[note]You can [b]log[/b] messages to inform what the code is doing or alert that there’s an issue.[/note]

content.text:
控制台是浏览器的一部分，它提供了一些实用的功能，例如记录网页的日志和调试网络请求。您可以使用`console.log()`方法将消息记录到控制台中，以便在开发时跟踪程序状态和调试。您还可以使用控制台来模拟不同的网络速度和设备，以测试网页在不同环境下的性能和兼容性。

在下面的示例代码中，"*All good, no errors*" 的消息被发送到控制台。
content.text_html:
The console is part of the web browser. Logging (writing) messages to the console is a good way to diagnose and troubleshoot minor issues in your code.

You can use **console.log() **to write or log messages. In the example code below, the message 'All good, no errors' is sent to the console.

控制台是网络浏览器的一部分。向控制台记录（写）信息是诊断和排除你的代码中的小问题的好方法。

你可以使用console.log()来写或记录信息。在下面的示例代码中，"一切正常，没有错误 "的消息被发送到控制台。

content.text: 你也可以通过`console.log`来 **记录** 一些信息，用来标记我们实现的Javascript代码运行的时候正在做什么，或者用于提醒代码在运行的过程中是否有问题。
content.text_html:
You can log messages to inform what the code is doing or alert that there’s an issue.

你可以记录信息，告知代码正在做什么，或者提醒有问题。

resolved.question_text: 下面那个指令用于在浏览器的控制台打印消息？
resolved.question_text_html: Which command is used to log or write messages to the console?

resolved.title: 打印字符串文本
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Text Messages[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Text in JavaScript needs to be enclosed in [b]quotes[/b].[code format="js" codeId="5607"]console.log('Testing in progress')
 [/code]
[note]Your JavaScript code won’t work if you don’t include a [b]pair of quotation marks [/b]around the text message. You can use either [b]single[/b] or [b]double quotation marks[/b].
[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Text Messages[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Text in JavaScript needs to be enclosed in [b]quotes[/b].[code format="js" codeId="5607"]console.log('Testing in progress')
 [/code]
[note]Your JavaScript code won’t work if you don’t include a [b]pair of quotation marks [/b]around the text message. You can use either [b]single[/b] or [b]double quotation marks[/b].
[/note]

content.text: Javascript中的文本或者字符串，需要用引号括起来。
content.text_html:
Text in JavaScript needs to be enclosed in quotes.

JavaScript中的文本需要用**引号括起来。

content.js_code:
console.log('Testing in progress')

// 或者 console.log("Testing in progress")

content.text: 如果你不在文本信息的前后加上引号，你的JavaScript代码将无法工作。你可以使用**单引号** `''` 或**双引号** `""`。
注：编程语言语法中的引号都是英文半角，若代码运行过程中提示引号错误，请检查是否是引号是中文输入法的引号。
content.text_html:
Your JavaScript code won’t work if you don’t include a **pair of quotation marks **around the text message. You can use either single or double quotation marks.

如果你不在文本信息周围加上对引号，你的JavaScript代码将无法工作。你可以使用单引号或双引号**。

resolved.question_text:
选择正确的选项，使得代码能够在控制台打印选中的文本。

```JavaScript_typein

```

Drag and drop to send the message to the console.
[!raw!]
